name: Valson Industries Limited
about: Valson Industries Limited manufactures and sells polyester texturized and twisted yarns under the VALSON brand name in India and internationally. The company is engaged in the processing of cotton, polyester, and other fancy yarns. It also offers nylon, cotton, space, and spun and fancy dyed yarns. The company was formerly known as Valson Synthetics Ltd and changed its name to Valson Industries Limited in October 1998. Valson Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
